subject: Separation briefing & evidence plan for Surreptix Dedicated/Private
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@surreptix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: IT Security <infosec@surreptix.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Separation briefing & evidence plan for Surreptix Dedicated/Private

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're starting our internal security review for a potential Dedicated deployment and want to collect the architecture and evidence that our auditors will expect. Specifically, could you provide the following: 

- A high-level network diagram showing tenant fencing for both Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private (annotated for AWS/GCP overlays).
- An "isolation control matrix" that maps configuration controls to SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2 criteria (or guidance if a direct mapping isn't 1:1).
- A short narrative (1–2 pages) explaining how tenant KV/prefix caching, control-plane partitioning, and fallback routing preserve tenant separation.
- Representative runbook snippet for an incident that demonstrates egress/egress-blocking and audit log extraction.

Timeline: our auditor (Sam Samuels from Blue Audit) would like preliminary materials by COB 2027-09-06. Procurement may request pricing/contract redlines afterward. Can you confirm who on your side will own the technical packaging and whether you can deliver an annotated diagram that we can hand to auditors?

Also: we have a hard requirement to know whether the Private offering supports customer-managed KMS in a VPC/on-prem context — a short statement is sufficient.

Appreciate it,
Alex Turner
Director, IT Security
Surreptix

---
Attachments: none

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@surreptix.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Separation briefing & evidence plan for Surreptix Dedicated/Private

Alex —

Thanks for the clear list. We can own the deliverable set. Quick plan below and a couple of clarifying Qs to make sure we provide what your auditor needs: 

Planned deliverables (preliminary package by 2027-09-06):
- redwood_topology_annotated_v1.pdf — high-level diagrams for Dedicated and Private with AWS/GCP callouts and an on-prem airgap overlay.
- isolation_control_matrix.csv — per-control mapping to SIG/CAIQ sections + suggested SOC 2 narrative pointers.
- soc2_control_mapping.docx — short 2-page narrative focused on separation, monitoring, and logging.
- seg-diagram-aurora.svg — vector diagram you can embed in an audit packet.
- sample runbook snippet and audit-log export example (redacted).

Clarifying Qs:
1) For the annotated diagram, do you want a single unified figure with overlays or separate PDF pages per environment?
2) For KMS — are you asking for proof that Private supports customer-managed KMS (Y/N) or a configuration guide?

Kimberly (security) and Marissa (infra) are looped for technical validation. Kimberly — can your team prepare the control matrix and the SOC 2 narrative? Marissa — can you assemble the annotated diagrams and the runbook snippet?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Ben — quick answers to your questions and one refinement from our auditor: 

1) Diagrams: separate pages please (Dedicated, Private, and an "airgap/on-prem" overlay) — that helps Sam reference sections.
2) KMS: we need a 1-2 sentence attestation that Private supports customer-managed keys (KMS) and how keys are used for model artifacts and persistent KV/caches. A config guide is nice-to-have later.

Auditor note (Sam): Sam asked for explicit mapping of network choke points and the evidence location (e.g., where to find VPC flow logs, control-plane audit logs, and sample retention windows). He also asked that any sensitive IPs be redacted in the initial drop.

Procurement is copied — they will follow up on contract/insurance items after the technical packet.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@surreptix.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, IT Security <infosec@surreptix.com>, Sam Samuels <sam.samuels@blue-audit.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Separation briefing & evidence plan for Surreptix Dedicated/Private

Alex / Sam / Procurement —

Appreciate the specificity — we're putting together the requested package and will deliver the preliminary artifacts by COB 2027-09-06. Summary of what you'll get and a few operational notes below: 

Deliverables (prelim):
- redwood_topology_annotated_v1.pdf (3 pages: Dedicated, Private, On-prem overlay). Each page includes callouts for control-plane partitioning, egress choke points, and caching boundaries. Sensitive IPs redacted.
- seg-diagram-aurora.svg (editable vector for embedding in packets).
- isolation_control_matrix.csv (columns: Control, SIG/CAIQ Ref, SOC2-CC Ref, Evidence Location).
- soc2_control_mapping.docx (2 pages) with explicit language you can hand to an auditor.
- runbook_snippet.txt (redacted incident steps showing egress block + audit-log extraction).

KMS attestation (short):
- Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest of persistent stores and model artifacts when deployed in customer VPCs or on-prem packages. Keys can be provided via the customer's cloud KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) or HSM integrations; key access is limited to the customer tenancy and never shared across tenants. We'll include the 1–2 sentence attestation in the SOC 2 narrative doc.

Evidence locations / retention (example pointers we'll enumerate in the CSV):
- VPC Flow Logs (S3 path) — retention: 90 days (default), extendable via contract.
- Control-plane audit logs (immutable append-only bucket) — TTL: 365 days (can be configured).
- Tokenized request traces (anonymized) — retained 30 days by default.

Next steps: Ben will run point on delivery logistics; we'll supply editable diagram and the CSV. If Sam wants a short walkthrough call after the drop (15–30m) to step through the mapping, we can schedule that for the following week.

Ben — we'll attach the prelim files in the next message / Drive link.

Kimberly Park
Head of Security Architecture
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments (to be delivered): redwood_topology_annotated_v1.pdf; isolation_control_matrix.csv; soc2_control_mapping.docx; seg-diagram-aurora.svg; runbook_snippet.txt
